name: Full-body routine
notes: This plan works your whole body in each session. Rest a day between workouts. Great for beginners. Weights are starting placeholders — use what you can finish with 1–2 reps in reserve.

activities.name: Full-body strength
activities.instructions: Squats, push-ups, and rows. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell at the chest. Sit between the hips, then stand tall.
exercises.notes: Bodyweight squats are fine if you are new to this.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands under the shoulders. Lower the chest, then press up. Drop to the knees if you need to.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.instructions: Hinge, keep the torso still, and pull the elbow toward the hip.

activities.name: Full-body strength
activities.instructions: Deadlifts and overhead press. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, keep the dumbbells close to the legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press
exercises.instructions: Brace, press up, and do not over-arch the lower back.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips.

activities.name: Full-body strength
activities.instructions: Lunges and core. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunge
exercises.instructions: Long step, back knee close to the floor, torso tall. Count reps per leg.
exercises.notes: Bodyweight lunges are fine if you are new to this.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.instructions: Lower the legs without the lower back peeling off the floor.

exercises.name: Front plank
exercises.instructions: Ribs down, glutes on. Hold still.
